hcontainer.p: (8) Equally, considering the nature of the activities in the processing and marketing of fishery and aquaculture products, and the similarities between those activities and other processing and marketing activities, this Regulation should apply to undertakings active in the processing and marketing of fishery and aquaculture products, provided that certain conditions are met. Neither on-farm or on-board activities necessary for preparing an animal or plant for the first sale (including cutting, filleting or freezing), nor the first sale to resellers or processors should be considered as processing or marketing in this respect and this Regulation should therefore not apply to those activities.
